```{pyodide-python}
import matplotlib
print("Matplotlib backend:", matplotlib.get_backend())

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots()

x, y = np.meshgrid(
    np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 20),
    np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 20)
)

z = np.sin(x - y/4)*np.sin(y)

cs = ax.contourf(x, y, z)
fig.colorbar(cs, ax=ax)

plt.show()
```
